lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs₂AgSeI crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group C222₁ (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Cs₈Ag₄Se₄I₄) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers in a tetrahedral environment with one I and three Se neighbors, while Cs adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve neighbors and Se is four-coordinate to Ag. The Ag tetrahedra share corners with one another and faces with Cs 12-vertex polyhedra, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
